Query Text: WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (
	SELECT 1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT n + 1 FROM r WHERE n < 100
)
SELECT count(*) FROM r;

          ->  WorkTable Scan on r r_1  (cost=0.00..0.23 rows=3 width=4) (actual time=0.000..0.000 rows=0.99 loops=100)
                Filter: (n < 100)
                Rows Removed by Filter: 0
